title: VPAT/ACR Report Generator input
description: Scan pages with axe-core and generate an evidence-backed draft ACR mapped to WCAG 2.2 A/AA, EN 301 549 and VPAT 2.5Rev criteria.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to scan. The Actor crawls further pages on the same hostname up to Max pages. Each scanned page is charged as one page-scanned event ($0.01).

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Hard cap on pages scanned per report.

edition.title: VPAT edition
edition.description: Which VPAT 2.5Rev edition the report targets. EU adds EN 301 549 clause mapping, needed for EAA-related procurement.

includeScreenshots.title: Include screenshots
includeScreenshots.description: Save a full-page screenshot per scanned page as evidence in the Key-Value Store.

reportFormat.title: Report formats
reportFormat.description: Report formats to produce. Markdown and DOCX both need no external files.

reportMetadata.title: Report header details
reportMetadata.description: Vendor and product information printed in the report header.

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Vendor company name for the ACR header.
